coverageNotes: Kanto service furniture uses the supplied source demo pixels.
Johto service furniture uses the supplied Pokémon Heart and Soul art; its Centre is Kanto-style, not HGSS.
Hoenn Centre uses genuine retained Emerald secondary metatiles from HNS map30.85; Hoenn Mart shares HNS Emerald-style artwork.
TRE service-map graphics did not render coherently and were deliberately excluded.
No NPC sprites or working healing/shop/battle scripts are implied by furniture placement.
